text:
Emily (Partnerships PM): Heads up — we need a clear partner SEV routing map for marketplace and SI partners. Current ad-hoc routing is creating delays. Proposal below, want quick feedback and ownership.
Carlos (EngOps): +1. Can you share the proposed channel names and oncall handoffs?
Emily (Partnerships PM): Thinking: a shared channel per partner org + a single cross-partner warroom pattern. e.g. `#partner-<org>-support` and warroom `#warroom/partner/<org>/sev1`. Keep public metadata minimal.
Sara (SRE): I like the warroom pattern. Need an automation hook so when SEV1 is raised it creates the channel and posts the runbook. Example command: `/warroom create partner=acme severity=sev1 template=partner-basic`
opsbot: Automation note — we can add a sabre hook to auto-create and invite people. See draft runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/partner-sev (draft).
Ryan (Sales Eng): For marketplace partners we need to loop in marketplace ops (mp-ops) + partner PM. Suggest invite list: `@mp-ops`, `@partner-pm`, `@se-oncall`, `@cs-psr`.
Jessica (Customer Success): Also include a single point of contact from the SI (contact tree) — we had a case where multiple SI folks replied and nobody triaged. Need contact priority levels.
Emily (Partnerships PM): Proposed contact tree: level1 = partner oncall (email/sms), level2 = SI tech lead, level3 = partner exec. We'll keep that in partner onboarding doc.
Carlos (EngOps): Can we standardize the escalation timeboxes? e.g., ack within 10m, triage in 30m, workaround in 2h for SEV1.
Sara (SRE): Those SLA boxes are fine. Add an automated pager escalation if no ack in 10m. Ops runbook snippet: ```
- On SEV1: create warroom
- Post initial triage template
- Assign action owner
- If no ack in 10m -> escalate to @se-oncall
```
Emily (Partnerships PM): Handling cross-partner incidents: if multiple partners impacted, create `#warroom/partners/global-sev` and follow global playbook.
Ryan (Sales Eng): For marketplace listing issues we might want a separate fast-path to marketplace infra to avoid long handoffs. Maybe `@mp-ops-fastpath` role.
Jessica (Customer Success): Also requesting a short onboarding checklist for partners that covers SEV routing, contact tree, expected SLAs, and who to CC on P1s. We'll include in onboarding packet.
Carlos (EngOps): I'll draft a YAML template for partner config we can store in infra repo: `partner_config/<org>.yaml` with fields: `contact_tree`, `oncall_handles`, `warroom_template`, `fastpath_roles`. Would help automation.
opsbot: Reminder — we can attach PagerDuty escalation policies programmatically if we have partner metadata. See internal API: `POST /internal/pd/policies`
Emily (Partnerships PM): Next steps: Carlos to draft partner_config template, Sara to add warroom automation hooks, Jessica to add checklist to onboarding, Ryan to propose marketplace fast-path, I'll consolidate and circulate runbook by EOD Friday. Anyone object?
Sara (SRE): No objections. I'll slot a quick demo for opsbot automation next Tue.
Ryan (Sales Eng): Sounds good — I'll coordinate with mp-ops.
Jessica (Customer Success): 👍 happy to help write the onboarding checklist.
Carlos (EngOps): Will send a PR with template by tomorrow noon.
Emily (Partnerships PM): Thanks all — keeping this thread as the working thread. Tag me if you hit blockers. :raised_hands:
opsbot: Channel archived note: This thread will be mirrored into `#partnerships-ops-archive` after resolution.
